description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain known for by-the-slice and whole-pie orders with any toppings included in the base price. This South Vancouver franchise location on Southwest Marine Drive offers takeout and delivery, making it a convenient fuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area. The chain also operates a not-for-profit arm, Freshslice Cares, supporting youth sports in local communities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record confirms a Freshslice Pizza fast_food location at 498 Southwest Marine Drive, Vancouver, with takeaway=yes and delivery=yes tags. The website (corporate/chain site) confirms the brand, pizza menu, takeout/delivery ordering, vegetarian pizza options, and a gluten-free cauliflower crust listed in the allergen/nutritional chart. No location-specific amenity information (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) appears anywhere on the corporate website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: The fetched website is a corporate/chain site and contains no location-specific information for the 498 Southwest Marine Drive franchise; amenity details for this specific location cannot be verified from it.

Website contact page shows corporate HQ address (1610 Ingleton Avenue, Burnaby BC, V5C 5R9) and a different corporate phone (604-251-7444), so OSM location address and phone cannot be cross-confirmed via the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food pizza chain location. Useful to touring cyclists as a takeout food stop in South Vancouver.
